invariants.claim: A continuing call is in Status.Refunding and has a batch length in [1,100].
Each completed loop iteration consumed a live ticket owned exactly by msg.sender; approvals alone are insufficient.
A source-created live ticket has one stored inclusive range whose length equals its purchased entryCount, and the range survives burning.

On success, every submitted ticket is burned, remainingRefundLiability and the quote balance are reduced by the same calculated amount under the quote-token trust model, and TicketsRefunded reports the post-decrement liability.
No external call occurs inside the ticket loop; the external factory/token boundary is reached only after all burns and the liability decrement.

assumptions.claim: remainingRefundLiability covers all still-live refund claims.
assumptions.established_by: Purchases add entryCount * ENTRY_PRICE to unsettledPot; enableRefunds moves that pot to remainingRefundLiability; each successful refund burns before subtracting the identical claim amount.

assumptions.claim: The concrete quote token is official, standard, fee-free, non-rebasing six-decimal USDC and credits exactly amount on accepted transfer.
assumptions.established_by: Declared trust/deployment assumption; exact on-chain identity and recipient/balance delta verification: nothing found.

assumptions.claim: factory implements the IRaffleFactory getters used during payout destination screening.
assumptions.established_by: Canonical RaffleFactory construction path deploys the implementation; direct noncanonical Raffle deployment is not type-checked.

loop_paths: Empty or >100-element batch reverts before iteration.
Foreign-owned ID reverts before range accounting.
A duplicate burns on its first occurrence, then reverts in ownerOf on the second; transaction rollback restores prior iteration effects.
Every-success path aggregates each inclusive range, burns every ticket, prices the aggregate, decrements liability, transfers quote tokens, and emits the aggregate event.

callees.name: nonReentrant
callees.depends_on: Reject nested guarded calls and keep the guard entered through the final external transfer.

callees.name: ownerOf/_requireOwned
callees.depends_on: Return the current nonzero owner or revert for never-minted/burned IDs.

callees.name: ticketRange
callees.depends_on: Return the stored historical endpoints; existence/order come from ownerOf and buyEntries, not this callee.

callees.name: _burn/_update
callees.depends_on: Clear approval/ownership, decrement owner balance, and emit Transfer without an external call; exact-owner authorization is supplied by the caller.

callees.name: _transferQuote/_isProtocolDestination
callees.depends_on: Reject known protocol sinks, then transfer the complete claim; factory getter ABI calls must succeed.

callees.name: SafeERC20.safeTransfer/quoteToken.transfer
callees.depends_on: Bubble revert; accept true or code-bearing empty-return success; trusted token must actually move exactly amount.

shared_state: status: lifecycle writers gate entry into the refund branch.
ERC721 owners/balances/approvals: minted by buyEntries, transferable in every state, burned here and by winner redemption in disjoint result states.
_ticketRanges/totalEntries/ticketCount: purchase-time lifetime records; read but not reduced by refunds.
remainingRefundLiability: initialized by enableRefunds, decremented only by successful refunds, included by accountedQuoteBalance.
quote-token balance: increased by purchases and decreased by the final external transfer.
open_questions: Need deployed quote-token bytecode/configuration to establish exact official-USDC identity and fee-free, non-rebasing, no-callback transfer semantics.
Need concrete deployment provenance when applying this record outside the canonical RaffleFactory construction path, because Raffle later ABI-calls its constructor caller as IRaffleFactory.
